messages:
ash: Quick note: small tokenization micro-regression after recent change to utf8 scanning. Noticed ~6% CPU increase in tokenize::scan_utf8 during ingress profiling for short prompts.
maria: did the tokenizer change land in the same release as other patches?
perf-bot: deploy 2026-03-23T10:01 by @ci (tokenizer-optim:v2) -> canary 10% -> promoted 10:03
john: sample top functions from pprof:
```
# top 8
18.0% tokenize::scan_utf8
12.0% parse_proto_frame
9.0% kernel_selector::evaluate
7.5% writev_coalesce
6.0% grpc::frame_assembly
5.0% kv_cache::lookup
3.5% telemetry::emit
```
ash: tokenization change was intended to reduce allocations but introduced extra branching for short ASCII sequences. Maria, can you revert the micro-branching for short sequences?
maria: yeah patch in progress. but also we should add unit perf-tests for 0-64 token inputs to prevent regressions.
perf-bot: CI perf test failed for 50-token test by +5.8% CPU.
ash: okay revert and add perf test, and also run wrk with streaming enabled to capture writev/hpack interactions.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated at 10:10 by @maria (tokenizer-optim revert) -> canary 10%
john: follow-up: add telemetry `short_input_tokenize_cycles` and baseline it. Also test with both http and grpc since framing changes hit tokenization differently.
ash: agreed. I'll create the PR and link this thread.
